title: killed Work Regional Visa (Subclass 491): Complete Guide
author: scarlettwatson
contentHtml:
If you're a skilled worker looking to build a future in regional Australia, the Visa Subclass 491 could be the perfect option for you. Officially known as the Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa, this visa allows skilled workers to live and work in designated regional areas of Australia for up to five years, with a clear pathway to permanent residency.

What is Visa Subclass 491?

The Subclass 491 visa is a points-tested, provisional visa for skilled workers who are nominated by a state or territory government or sponsored by an eligible family member living in a regional area. This visa encourages migration to less populated regions of Australia, helping to address skill shortages and stimulate local economies.

Key Features of the Subclass 491 Visa

  • Duration: Valid for 5 years

  • Work and Study: Permitted in designated regional areas

  • Pathway to PR: Eligible to apply for permanent residency via Subclass 191 after meeting specific requirements

  • Family Sponsorship: Available if you have a relative living in regional Australia

  • Points Test: Applicants must score at least 65 points under the Department of Home Affairs system

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the 491 visa, you must:

  • Be nominated by a state or territory government, or sponsored by an eligible family member

  • Have an occupation listed on the Skilled Occupation List

  • Obtain a suitable skills assessment

  • Be under 45 years of age at the time of invitation

  • Achieve a competent level of English

  • Pass the points test

Benefits of the 491 Visa

  • Priority Processing: Regional visas like the Subclass 491 often receive faster processing

  • Access to Medicare: Eligible for public healthcare services

  • Pathway to PR: After three years of living and working in a regional area and meeting income requirements, you can apply for the Subclass 191 visa

  • Family Members Included: You can include eligible family members in your application

Regional Areas Covered

Designated regional areas include most parts of Australia except for major cities like Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane. Cities such as Adelaide, Hobart, and Canberra, along with many rural towns, are considered regional for the purpose of the Subclass 491 visa.

Application Process

  1. Check Eligibility & Points

  2. Submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) via SkillSelect

  3. Seek Nomination or Sponsorship

  4. Receive an Invitation to Apply

  5. Lodge Your Visa Application

  6. Wait for a Decision

Conclusion

The Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa Subclass 491 is an excellent opportunity for skilled migrants to settle in Australia’s thriving regional communities. With its pathway to permanent residency and support from state governments or family sponsors, this visa has become increasingly popular among international applicants.
